svg.title: PdaSearch — End-to-End Hybrid Search Architecture
svg.desc: A presentation-ready architecture diagram showing upstream attribute preparation, Oracle and file-based loading, cache validation, normalized document embeddings, metadata and source records, on-demand character and word TF-IDF indexing, query preparation, semantic and lexical search, sequential reranking or union aggregation, optional threshold filtering, final result selection, enrichment and a standardized user-interface response.
svg.text: Combining semantic understanding and lexical precision to discover relevant data attributes
Source Data → Hybrid Retrieval → Ranked Results
Upstream feature preparation and service initialization; lexical indexing is deferred until first use
Standardize the query → compare attributes → rank candidates → enrich the response

g.text: Consolidate descriptive fields into one string.
Generated before PdaSearch loads the dataset.
The same attribute text supports lexical matching.
Reuse cached assets for faster future loading
Separate CSV load → complete source rows + header + row index
One embedding representation per source record
Unit-length vectors: dot product = cosine similarity
Ready for meaning-based matching after data loading
Row index · physical column · source identifiers
Retrieve complete source records using the row index.
Shared context for indexing and final result enrichment
Build on the first lexical request · retain for reuse
Corpus: searchable embedding text from every document
Fit both vectorizers across the full searchable corpus.
TF-IDF weights reflect pattern importance across documents.
Reuse the fitted models to transform incoming queries.
Built when needed—not assumed to be preloaded offline files.

svg.text: Character + word models and sparse TF-IDF matrices

g.text: Selected methods execute according to the configured pipeline.
Query → compatible embedding model → query vector
L2-normalize the query vector to unit length.
Compute a dot product with stored normalized embeddings.
Output: cosine similarity measuring conceptual relevance
Transform the query with the same fitted TF-IDF models.
Output: average of character and word similarity scores
Retrieve broad candidate pools before selecting the final matches.
Fetch complete source records and associated metadata.
Linked back to the original dataset
Present similarity on a user-friendly 0–100% scale.
Consistent, contextual records for the application / UI

svg.text: Embeddings encode meaning. Reranking is similarity-based; no separate learned reranker is shown.
Branches show configurable retrieval methods—not guaranteed parallel execution.
